Swiss-Cheese Block

Read `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\holes.csv`, subtract the eight listed spheres from a `10 x 10 x 10 m` cube, and export the result as `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\answer.skp`.

Ensure that the resulting model is watertight, keeps the full `10 m` extents, matches the expected volume within `2%`, and has an Euler characteristic consistent with either eight enclosed cavities (`chi = 18`) or eight through-holes (`chi = -14`).
source: SU-Help Solid Tools Subtract; CSG primer
